answer_1.quote: Automatic metrics are an indispensable part of machine translation (MT) evaluation, serving as a proxy to human evaluation...

answer_2.quote: Automatic metrics compute the quality of an MT output (or set of translations) by comparing it with a reference translation...

answer_4.quote: Following , we use direct assessment (DA) scores collected as part of the human evaluation at WMT 2019. Annotators are asked to rate the adequacy of a set of translations...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate the adequacy of translations on a continuous scale from 0 to 100.
